notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup + quick demo request. Small B2B SaaS (in-app assistants for customer success teams). Primary ask: low-latency streaming chat for web and mobile widgets. They signed up, created API key, and ran smoke tests on Hosted API; reached out via contact form for performance questions.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2026-02-15: self-serve signup (trial credits claimed). AE Jordan P follow-up email with quickstart link. Gmail thread id: 1638475a2b-thread.
- 2026-02-18: Fireflies call (ff-5729) with Founder/CTO (A. Venk) — 20m. Notes: "users notice ~300-500ms lag on our alpha", wants p50 <200ms for typing/streaming feel.
- 2026-02-22: Internal dev notes from Hyperslate: integrated Redwood JS SDK, basic streaming working, saw p50=180ms, p95=420ms from East US tests. Uploaded latency harness results to drive/redwood/hyperslate-prod-pricing-deck-v2.pdf.

Use-case & requirements (from calls/notes):
- Workload: in-app chat assistant that streams partial responses to reduce perceived latency. Also lightweight summarization of conversation for support tickets.
- Latency targets: p50 <200ms, p90 <400-600ms depending on region; graceful degradation acceptable (shorter responses) but must stay interactive.
- Throughput: modest — average concurrent users 10-30, spikes to 200 daily during office hours.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget-conscious; wants predictable per-token estimate for planning. Estimated ARR ask ~$5–20k/year.
- Model prefs: open-source or Redwood-curated smallest acceptable model for streaming; willing to test 7B/13B quantized variants. Requests explicit guidance on batching and KV cache for session continuity.
- Routing/fallbacks: must support automatic fallback to lower-capacity cheaper variant when latency/backpressure detected; developer control for canary rollout.
- Security/compliance: public cloud ok; wants SSO for admin console, audit logs retained 90 days, and basic KMS integration for keys. No enterprise-only requirements (no air-gapped).

POC plan discussed:
- Phase 1 (this month): validate streaming latency on Hosted API from EU and US regions; measure p50/p95 at client sampling points.
- Phase 2 (2–4 weeks): run 2-week trial with sample user traffic (10k–50k tokens) and collect cost numbers; iterate on model variant and batching.
- Phase 3 (post-trial): switch to reserved Dedicated only if growth requires predictable throughput.

Quotes / snippets from founder: "Our product feels sluggish if streaming lags by >200ms — retention drops." "We need a cost estimate we can show investors for Q3 runway."

Technical notes for SE handoff (summary):
- Client SDK integrated, streaming works, but they saw variability across regions.
- Recommended to test continuous-batching and prefix caching; evaluate Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization.
- Ask SE to provide a quick table: model variant vs expected p50/p95 (east-us, eu-west) + per-token cost estimate at 30k and 300k tokens/month.
